{
  "problem_id": "TA-009",
  "lane_id": "openai-governed",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "OpenAI o3-pro-class reasoning agents as the primary research and critic runtime, GPT-4.1-class models for literature ingestion and manuscript processing, isolated verifier agents, code execution, theorem-prover integration, and parallel experiment workers",
  "execution_posture": "governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 30000000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 6000000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 45000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 120000,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 111000,
  "estimated_retries": 36000,
  "estimated_search_cost": 300000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 550000,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 1200000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 1800000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 7000000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 28000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 6000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 26000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 80000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.28,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.38,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.045,
  "confidence": 0.22,
  "assumptions": {
    "estimate_type": "Prospective resource forecast, not a claim of observed feasibility and not derived from any published aggregate cost estimate.",
    "scope": "A full program covering literature ingestion, citation and dependency mapping, a contamination-controlled blind rediscovery phase, proof-aware reconstruction, broad exploratory branching, computational experiments, critic passes, failed approaches, formalization of central arguments, independent replication, and manuscript preparation.",
    "probability_interpretation": {
      "estimated_success_probability": "Probability that the capped program produces a publishable, independently verified result matching the target, whether by reconstruction or a materially new derivation.",
      "estimated_reproduction_probability": "Probability of reconstructing and validating a known published proof after proof-aware literature access; this does not imply independent rediscovery.",
      "estimated_independent_result_probability": "Probability of obtaining a publishable derivation whose decisive ideas were generated in the blind phase and are materially independent of the known proof."
    },
    "token_accounting": "Output tokens exclude hidden reasoning tokens. Costing treats reasoning tokens as premium generated tokens and uses a blended planning rate across primary reasoning models, cheaper ingestion models, cache reuse, and verifier runs.",
    "parallelism": "Elapsed hours are wall-clock program duration under substantial parallel execution; aggregate agent-hours and accelerator-hours are much larger.",
    "search_cost_scope": "Literature retrieval, metadata and citation services, corpus preparation, sandboxed code execution, combinatorial searches, storage, proof-state indexing, and experiment replication.",
    "governance_breakdown_usd": {
      "identity_hashing_and_agent_attestation": 35000,
      "budget_enforcement_and_kill_switches": 90000,
      "branch_receipts_and_lineage_tracking": 170000,
      "evidence_preservation_and_artifact_retention": 130000,
      "policy_checks_and_governance_audits": 125000
    },
    "verification_cost_scope": "Isolated verifier-model lanes, clean-room proof reconstruction, rerunning computational artifacts, proof-assistant builds, adversarial lemma checking, citation audits, replication packaging, and limited independent expert review.",
    "formalization_scope": "Machine-checkable formalization of the main theorem interface and central novel lemmas, plus explicit dependency coverage for remaining arguments; a complete library-level formalization of every auxiliary fact would move the estimate toward the high case.",
    "cost_conditioning": "Totals represent the cost of running the planned capped program rather than probability-weighted cost per successful publication."
  },
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "Unknown conceptual distance between existing methods and the superexponential target.",
    "Whether the published argument relies on a small number of discoverable ideas or a long sequence of tightly coupled innovations.",
    "Model reliability on very long combinatorial dependency chains and asymptotic parameter bookkeeping.",
    "Difficulty detecting subtly false probabilistic, entropy, algebraic, or optimization steps.",
    "Degree to which useful computational experiments can guide a fundamentally asymptotic proof.",
    "Availability and machine readability of relevant literature, appendices, and implicit folklore lemmas.",
    "Formal-library coverage for the required combinatorics, probability, asymptotics, and finite constructions.",
    "Contamination controls needed to distinguish independent rediscovery from proof reconstruction.",
    "Future model pricing, context limits, inference latency, and effective parallel scaling.",
    "Amount of expert intervention ultimately required by journals or independent validators."
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A complete theorem statement with explicit quantifiers, asymptotic regime, constants or parameter dependencies, and comparison to prior bounds.",
    "A timestamped blind-phase research record showing the provenance of any claimed independent ideas.",
    "A proof dependency graph linking every major claim to proved lemmas or clearly identified standard results.",
    "Multiple adversarial critic passes with all substantive objections resolved and preserved as branch receipts.",
    "Independent clean-room reconstruction by verifier agents that did not share hidden research traces.",
    "Reproducible source code, fixed environments, seeds, logs, and certificates for every computationally used claim.",
    "Machine-checked versions of the central novel lemmas and automated consistency checks for asymptotic inequalities and parameter choices.",
    "A citation and novelty audit separating known ingredients, reconstructed arguments, and genuinely new contributions.",
    "At least two independent replications of computational experiments and formal builds.",
    "A publication-ready manuscript, supplementary proof details, artifact bundle, and explicit limitations statement."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "The target may require a conceptual innovation that search, scaling, and critic loops do not reliably generate.",
    "A plausible proof may contain a globally consequential but locally inconspicuous error that survives model self-review.",
    "Independent rediscovery may be impossible to substantiate if training data or retrieved literature exposed decisive proof ideas.",
    "Automated formalization may stall on missing libraries or arguments expressed through nonconstructive or highly bespoke combinatorics.",
    "Computational evidence cannot substitute for the required asymptotic proof.",
    "Parallel branches may converge on correlated mistakes because they share model priors and training data.",
    "Verification or novelty reviewers may require stronger formal coverage or genuinely human-independent corroboration than budgeted.",
    "Inference availability, rate limits, model changes, or governance constraints could materially extend elapsed time."
  ]
}
